notes.title: Mail
notes.notes:
Added mailbox system

and introducted a new character

hopefully this will give some more direction without signposting 

i still want the main vibe to be that your choosing your own goals / story through the world

notes.title: Hunter
notes.notes:
Added the hunter skill

(Can place traps to catch insects running through zones)

these provide food (bugs can be cooked)

and they provide seeds (can be planted in farming spots to grow herbs)

also reworked net code so now you can enter a code if you dont wish to play with everyone

and share that code if you only want to play with friends

notes.title: Farming and stuff
notes.notes:
This update introduces the progression of emotes being unlockable collectables in the game

and a starter cave for an early weapon (or money) to make the starter chunk a little faster if you didnt pick fighter in character creation

and it also introduces farming

but theres no way to get seeds yet

next update will be hunter to add a way to collect them

notes.title: Herblore - New zones
notes.notes:
Added a new skill with this update

Herblore

the residual gatherable from herbs is sand

if you use this at the furnace you will get smelting xp

cant use the vials yet

but eventually in the new area to the right of spawn there will be a quest in the potion hut

that will let you combine the herbs with the vials (once filled with water)

if you follow the path all the way around, through all of the new areas, eventually youll reach the other part ive been working on, which is the the first dragon

dragons like in runescape will use a different attack type with dragon fire, and will require anti fire potions (or something else) to protect against it to have a fair fight

i tried to make this fight extra special by implying theres safe spots everywhere, but the dragon is huge and strong, so will toss everything aside, and even smash through walls to chase you, its hard to cheese it once agro'd (but i tried to make sure it wasnt completely uncheesable for silly fun builds and pures)

----

real life has caught up to me, so im gona be unable to work on this in my spare time for a little while, maybe a week-ish

but once i get on top of things again ill be back on the update grind, shouldnt be too long, but if anyones waiting for updates, im sorry. progress will stall for a bit.

notes.title: Building system
notes.notes:
Wanted to try and introduce more near term goals on whichever path you choose

so ive started a system for building some of the unique structures in each zone instead of immediately having access to them

going to probably start working towards mapping out rough drafts of every intended area next

sorry things are still a mess, im not used to dealing with this amount of scope and the limited time

things should improve soon

notes.title: Ending
notes.notes:
Some minor gameplay changes

Finally finished all the dream sequences

But the big thing is ive spent the past month on the true ending, im really happy with how its turned out, its not accessible in game yet, but its in the build, dont wana spoil anything, so not going to mention anything about it, but im looking forward to getting everything hooked up to see if anyone finds it :D 

Will be back to map grinding for a while, need all of the areas planned out next, so i can know how much work there is to do, itll be messy for a while but hopefully should be faster this way.

Gona get some sleep now, sorry if theres any fires ive made with all the changes, ill be back on things tomorrow.
